newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian metals' prices mixed on weak world trends.
newsitem.headline: Indian metals' prices mixed on weak world trends.

text.p: Indian metals' prices were mixed on Friday on weak world trends, dealers said.
While tin and nickel fell against fresh supplies other base metals were mixed, they said.

Ready tin fell by 200 rupees to 35,500 rupees per quintal while ready nickel slid by 100 rupees to 38,500 rupees. Copper was steady at 11,800 rupees, zinc at 6,325 rupees and lead at 5,000 rupees per. Aluminium was unchangedt at 7,450 rupees.
Overall market sentiment was subdued at the close of the session. ---Bombay Commodities +91-22-265 9000
